title: 第一章 江宁第二章破限
content_zh:
;;
洛水县。
清晨。
缕缕晨曦洞穿云层，照射在古老的城墙上。
原本静谧的洛水县也早已变得热闹起来，四通八达的县城大道上已经充满了叫卖了，到处都是一片喧闹，叫卖的景象。
在洛水县东，一间篱笆围成的小院中。
江宁在木椅上向阳盘坐，手肘及膝，掌托下颚，此刻他手持一卷书籍静静翻读。
【神话纪元录】
这是一本杂书，记载了关于神灵的故事。
在大夏之前，据书中记载那是一个神人共存的世界。
江河有神，山川有神，神灵无处不在。
这虽然是一本看似荒诞的杂书，但是江宁此刻却是看的异常认真，可谓全神贯注。
【识文断字经验值+1】
......
【识文断字经验值+1】
......
良久，江宁翻到最后一页，缓缓收回目光，手中这本杂书也被他彻底合拢。
【此次翻阅书籍，识文断字经验值共计增加8点。】
下一刻。
他的面前瞬间浮现一个面板，一个只有他能看见的面板。

【名称】：江宁
【源能】：13.5
【技艺】：识文断字（圆满9681000）（特效：无）
“终于快达到满值了！也不知道这门识文断字的技艺达到满值后究竟会有何等变化。”
看着自己的面板，江宁心中颇为振奋。
前些天他遍览家中群书，无论是古籍通史，还是各类经义要文，纷纷被他看了個遍。
凭借这些书籍，他也终于将这门技艺一步一步从入门肝到精通，小成，再至大成。
每一次突破，他都感觉到自己的头脑变得更加清明，思维运转更快，耳聪目明。
据他所知，这分明是神所壮大带来的效果。
在大夏，儒道之中，读书可养神！
经过这段时间的苦读书籍，他已然发现面板的妙用。
这个面板可谓有化腐朽为神奇的力量，只要专心苦读书籍，便可让识文断字这门技艺不断成长，且一证永证。
如今任何他看过的书籍都栩栩如生的记载在他的脑海中，只需一个念头就可以回忆其中的一切。
而此刻，他距离这门技艺圆满后的突破也仅差最后的三十多点经验值，以他现在这种效率，待会只要再读一些书籍，就可肝出这三十多点的经验值。
以他现在的学识，不说多，参加科举考个童生或者是秀才那是手到擒来，毫不费力。
想到这里，江宁心中更是充满了期待。
来年的功名加身，完全可以改变自身现状。
“嘟嘟！”
“嘟嘟！！”
就在这时，一道软软糯糯的声音传入江宁耳中。

听到这声软糯之音，江宁瞬间回过神来。
顺着声音望过去，他就看到一位粉雕玉琢，双眼大大，扎着两个朝天辫的小女娃朝着他摇摇晃晃的跑来，肉嘟嘟的脸蛋更是分外引人注目。
看到自己这位年仅五岁的小侄女，江宁彻底回神。
“小豆包跑慢点！”
他脸上不由的露出淡淡的笑容。
content_en:
;;
Luoshui County.
early morning.
Wisps of morning light penetrated the clouds and shone on the ancient city wall.
The originally quiet Luoshui County has already become lively. The county roads extending in all directions are full of hawkers, and there is a scene of noisy hawkers everywhere.
In the east of Luoshui County, in a small courtyard surrounded by fences.
Jiang Ning sat cross-legged on a wooden chair facing the sun, with his elbows reaching his knees and his chin resting on his palms. At this moment, he was holding a book and reading quietly.
【Mythic Chronicles】
This is a miscellaneous book that records stories about gods.
Before Bactria, according to books, it was a world where gods and humans coexisted.
Rivers have gods, mountains and rivers have gods, and gods are everywhere.
Although this is a seemingly absurd miscellaneous book, Jiang Ning is reading it very seriously at the moment, and he is completely focused on it.
[Literacy and hyphenation experience value +1]
...
[Literacy and hyphenation experience value +1]
...
After a long time, Jiang Ning turned to the last page and slowly looked away. The miscellaneous book in his hand was completely closed by him.
[After reading the books this time, the experience value of literacy and hyphenation increased by 8 points in total. 】
The next moment.
A panel instantly appeared in front of him, a panel that only he could see.
[Name]: Jiangning
[Source energy]: 13.5
[Skills]: Reading and Hyphenation (Perfect 9681000) (Special Effects: None)
"Finally, it's almost reaching its full value! I don't know how this skill of reading and deciphering words will change after it reaches its full value."
Looking at his own panel, Jiang Ning felt quite excited.
A few days ago, he read through the books at home, whether they were ancient books, general history, or various classics and essential texts, he read them all.
With the help of these books, he finally took this skill step by step from beginner to proficient, to minor success, and then to great success.
With every breakthrough, he felt that his mind became clearer, his thoughts worked faster, and his ears and eyes became clearer.
As far as he knew, this was clearly the effect of God's growth.
In Daxia, among Confucianism and Taoism, reading can nourish the mind!
After studying hard during this period of time, he has discovered the wonderful use of panels.
This panel can be said to have the power to turn decay into magic. As long as you concentrate on studying books, you can continue to grow in the art of reading and deciphering, and once you prove it, it will last forever.
Now any book he has read is vividly recorded in his mind, and he can recall everything in it with just a thought.
At this moment, he is only the last thirty points of experience points away from achieving a breakthrough in this skill. With his current efficiency, he can gain these thirty points of experience points by just reading some more books later.
With his current knowledge, not to mention, it would be effortless to take part in the imperial examination and become a boy or a scholar.
Thinking of this, Jiang Ning's heart was filled with expectations.
The addition of fame in the coming year can completely change your current situation.
"Dudu!"
"Dudu!!"
At this moment, a soft and waxy voice came into Jiang Ning's ears.
Hearing this soft and waxy sound, Jiang Ning came back to his senses instantly.
Following the sound, he saw a little girl with big eyes and two upward braids staggering towards him. Her chubby face was particularly eye-catching.
Seeing his little niece who was only five years old, Jiang Ning completely came back to his senses.
"Little bean bag, run slower!"
A faint smile couldn't help but appear on his face.
